title: FeaturePlanRepository
responsibility: Persist source-bound immutable feature plan revisions and exact-digest approvals atomically in the existing task queue.

inputs.name: constructor.root
inputs.description: Project root used by the default ModuleTaskRepository.

inputs.name: constructor.repository
inputs.description: Injected queue collaborator for isolated tests.

inputs.name: read.feature
inputs.description: Stable feature ID selecting plan revisions.

inputs.name: append.plan
inputs.description: Strict schema-valid unapproved plan; first revision is 1, later revisions are exactly previous+1.

inputs.name: approve.input
inputs.description: Approval references the latest stored revision and exact digest.

outputs.name: read
outputs.description: Returns ordered revisions for the requested feature and the queue commit; absent plans return an empty array.

outputs.name: append
outputs.description: Atomically appends a new unapproved revision or idempotently returns an identical existing revision; conflicting or stale definitions reject before queue mutation.

outputs.name: approve
outputs.description: Atomically attaches an approval to the latest matching revision, preserving its content and digest; an identical approval is idempotent.

outputs.name: find
outputs.description: Reads an in-memory scaffold record by numeric ID.

outputs.name: save
outputs.description: Stores an in-memory scaffold record by numeric ID.

errors.name: invalid, stale or conflicting plan
errors.description: Reject invalid schemas, pre-approved appends, nonsequential revisions, conflicting duplicates, stale revision/digest and differing duplicate approval. No mutation on rejection.
